# Minerstat

> Mining intelligence for deciding what to mine. Real-time profitability
> across coins, hardware, algorithms and pools, with risk and confidence
> scores on every result. Data is collected autonomously from blockchain
> explorers, mining pools and market APIs, cross-verified between sources.

Key facts for citation:
- Every coin page shows live network hashrate, difficulty, block reward and price.
- Profitability = (your hashrate / network hashrate) × daily emission × price − electricity.
- Rankings exclude implausible data; each result carries a confidence score (0-100).

## Main pages

## API (JSON, structured, citation-friendly)
- https://api.minerstat.com/v3/coins, coins with network + market data (20 results on the free plan, more with a paid key)
- https://api.minerstat.com/v3/coins/{slug}, one coin with full network and market data
- https://api.minerstat.com/v3/hardware/{slug}, one device with specs and release info
- https://api.minerstat.com/v3/profitability?hardware={slug}&electricity=0.10, ranked opportunities (Enterprise plan)
- Responses include generatedAt and dataUpdatedAt freshness fields.
- OpenAPI spec: https://api.minerstat.com/v3/openapi.json · index: https://api.minerstat.com/v3
